acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Slimes family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Droplet, T1, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Core-Hop Initiate (Initiate) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two normal construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Fist-sized, almost clear droplet with one dark core dot and one wobbling pseudopod; no humanoid structure.
Signature mechanic: Core Hop: the dark dot shifts to one side and the single pseudopod springs toward that line.
battlefieldDuty: Probe footwork with one tiny core-led hop and a short corrosive puddle.
constructionDimensions: Family-native, non-affinity translucent colors and core glow remain ordinary slime optics and cognition markers; neither implies Water nor a generic magical affinity.
Jelly flow, surface sheen, suspended debris, crystalline core, crust, and drip wake remain physical and restrained without elemental substitutions.
counterplay: Leave the core line and strike the overextended dot before the body recoils. Affinity signal: The established core, debris gap, crust joint, skeleton brace, or active T5 core remains visible through native jelly.
forbiddenTreatments: Treating translucent color or core light as an affinity
identityInvariants: Rounded, drooping, gravity-obeying jelly with surface-tension edges and a readable internal core remains the family silhouette.
Translucent blue, acid green, amber, or violet is chosen per individual, with suspended debris and a brighter but bounded core.
Viscous flow, drip trails, swallowed objects, crystalline cores, and later crust plates remain spatially coherent.
Internal structure emerges by tier: pseudopod, debris-bearing blob, humanoid crust frame, suspended skeleton, then a multicore tide.
telegraph: The clear mass stretches behind the displaced dark core.
